errors.finishEditFirst: Save or discard the edit in progress first.
errors.invalidSlug: The page name may use letters, digits, _ and -, and cannot start with -.
errors.pageExists: A page with that name already exists.
errors.editConflict: This page changed since you opened it. Copy your edit, discard it, and reapply it to the latest version.
errors.deleteConflict: This page changed since you opened it; reload it before deleting.

header.title: Global Knowledge Base
header.description: Durable knowledge shared by every session and workspace. Agents write it through the Wiki tool; edits here go through the same transaction, so the index and the change log stay in step.

list.empty: The knowledge base is empty. Agents add pages when you ask them to remember something, or create one here.

editor.title: Title
editor.rules: Pages cannot contain credentials, local file paths or file:// links. Existing sources are kept when you edit.

page.unreadableHint: Fix or remove the file under {{root}}; it is left out of search and the index until it parses.
page.selectPrompt: Select a page to read it, or create a new one.

health.title: Health
health.description: Unreadable pages, dead links, orphans, duplicates, unresolved conflicts and sources that have changed or disappeared.

history.title: History
history.description: Every committed change, newest first, from log.md.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this page?
deleteDialog.description: <path>{{path}}</path> will be removed from the Wiki and its index. The deletion is recorded in the history, but the content is not kept.
